meta.title: Sistrings — Violin & Viola Duo for Weddings & Events
meta.description: Sistrings is a duo of two sisters on violin and viola, bringing elegant live strings to weddings, corporate events, galas and private celebrations.

hero.tagline: Two sisters. Two strings. One unforgettable sound for life's most beautiful moments.

about.title: Two sisters, one sound
about.p1: Sistrings is a duo of two sisters who grew up sharing a music stand and never stopped. Both graduates of the National University of Music Bucharest, they pair conservatory precision with an instinct for each other that no rehearsal can teach — two instruments becoming a single, breathing voice.
about.p2: Blending the warmth of the viola with the brilliance of the violin, they move effortlessly from timeless classical to the songs everyone knows by heart — shaping the perfect atmosphere for your day, whatever the occasion.

events.title: Music for every occasion
events.subtitle: From the first note of a ceremony to the last dance of the night, we tailor the mood to your event.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.desc: Ceremonies, cocktails and receptions — walk down the aisle to a song that's truly yours.

corporate.title: Corporate & Galas
corporate.desc: Refined live strings that lift product launches, dinners and award nights.

private.title: Private Events
private.desc: Birthdays, anniversaries and intimate celebrations with a personal touch.

concerts.title: Concerts & Shows
concerts.desc: Full performances and collaborations for stages, festivals and venues.

ads.title: Music Videos & Commercials
ads.desc: The duo in an acoustic setting, special arrangements for songs in an intimate version. Special appearances for music videos or commercials.

repertoire.title: From Bach to the charts
repertoire.subtitle: A living songbook that spans centuries and genres — and we love learning your special request.
